settings.heading: Privacy
settings.intro: Choose what other people can see about you. Changes save straight away.
settings.under18: You’re under 18, so every setting here started at its most private choice. You can change them any time.
settings.loadFailed: Your privacy settings can’t be read right now. Try again in a moment.
settings.saveFailed: That didn’t save. Check your connection and try again.

profile.everyone: Everyone, including people without an account
profile.hint: Your pen name always shows on stories you publish. Your bio and the month you joined follow this choice.

online.label: Show when I’m online
online.hint: Off unless you turn it on. When it’s on, people you follow see a small dot by your name while you’re using the app.

library.hint: Your library is the stories on your Reading, Saved for later and Finished shelves. When other people can see it, it shows on your profile.

only_me.body: Only you can see the library.

people_i_follow.body: People you follow can see your library on your profile.

everyone.body: Everyone can see your library on your profile.

libraryNote.changeLabel: Change who can see the library

keep.heading: How long we keep things
keep.intro: Our clean-up jobs remove each kind of your data after these times. They run on their own, at least once a day.

kinds.deleted_content: Stories, chapters, comments and forum posts you delete: {{length}} after you delete them. Nobody else sees them in that time.
kinds.reported_messages: A private message that was reported: {{length}} after the moderators decide.
kinds.moderator_mail: Your messages with the moderation team: {{length}} after the last message.
kinds.support_tickets: Your messages to support: {{length}} after the request is closed.
kinds.reading_minutes: Minutes read each day, for your private reading streak: {{length}}.
kinds.scrambled_ip: The scrambled form of the address you signed up from: {{length}}. We never keep the address itself.
kinds.invites: Invitations you made: {{length}} after they expire.
kinds.account_deletion: Your account, after you ask to delete it: {{length}}, so you can change your mind.

keep.messages: Private messages: until both people delete the chat.
keep.fullList: The full list is in the privacy notice
keep.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this list. Try again in a minute.

suggest.label: Suggest me and my stories to other people
suggest.hint: Readers may then meet you in Writers to follow and New and rising writers. Turning it off takes you out of them at once. It starts on for adults and off for anyone under 18.
suggest.askParent: You’re under 16, so we suggest you only if your parent or guardian also says yes. We’ll email them one question.
suggest.waiting: Waiting for your parent. We don’t suggest you until they say yes.
suggest.sent: Sent. We emailed your parent or guardian.
suggest.parentAgreed: Your parent or guardian agreed, so readers may see you among our suggestions.

failures.signed_out: Log in again, then try once more.
failures.not_needed: There’s nothing to ask your parent right now.
failures.too_soon: We emailed them less than an hour ago. Try again later.
failures.unavailable: We couldn’t send the email. Try again in a moment.
failures.invalid: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
failures.own_email: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
failures.gone: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
failures.already_answered: Your parent or guardian has already answered.

readerLevel.hint: Your level comes from chapters read and stories finished. Hidden means only you see it on your profile.

personalDetails.label: Ask before I share contact details
personalDetails.hint: Before a comment, post, message or bio goes out, we check in this browser for something that looks like a phone number, an email address, a street address or a school’s name, and ask first. Nothing is saved or sent to anyone.
personalDetails.hintUnder18: On for everyone under 18. Before a comment, post, message or bio goes out, we check in this browser for something that looks like contact details, and ask first. Nothing is saved or sent to anyone.
personalDetails.question: This looks like personal contact details. Post anyway?
personalDetails.explain: A phone number, an email address, a street address or a school’s name lets people find you. Only you see this question.

readingSuggestions.label: Suggestions from reading
readingSuggestions.hint: Stories you finish count, as totals with no names, towards "Stories like this", and Discover shows "Because you read". Starts off under 18.
